papers.title: Online Marketplaces and Search Frictions for Small Firms
papers.abstract: We show that online marketplace participation lowers search frictions for small firms by expanding buyer reach and reducing customer acquisition costs.

papers.title: Search Costs, Matching Frictions, and Market Access
papers.abstract: A reduction in search costs improves market access by increasing the probability that small sellers and dispersed buyers match.
